blk_part_02_part_2_trading_investing_and.text: Trading usually means trying to benefit from shorter price moves. A trader may buy and sell often, like someone who keeps switching phone plans to catch a short discount. Investing usually means owning something for longer, so growth and compounding have time to work — more like planting a tree and waiting for shade. Both traders and investors sell, but their reasons and time periods can be different.
